title: Tenant-centric reporting exports with digest routing and format hints
creator: Amaya Patel
description:
Problem statement: Customers managing regulated workloads need scheduled, verifiable compliance exports that respect tenant residency and retention settings while minimizing operational cost. Current export tooling is brittle for large tenants (long-running jobs), does not allow per-tenant routing of payloads to region-specific sinks, and exposes limited metadata for auditors (no tamper-evident manifest, delivery proof, or content watermarking).

Goal: Deliver a tenant-oriented reporting export system that supports PDF and CSV outputs, region-aware delivery routing (S3 locations or secure webhook endpoints per residency), retention-aware delta exports, and an export catalog/dashboard with scheduling, preview, and cost estimates. Provide signed delivery manifests and optional per-file watermarking/obfuscation to meet audit requirements.

Key requirements:
- Support ad-hoc and scheduled exports in PDF and CSV. Exports should be packaged with a machine-readable manifest (JSON) and a signed delivery envelope (PKI signature) for tamper-evidence.
- Residency-aware routing: per-tenant routing rules that send final artifacts only to allowed regions or tenant-configured sinks. UI must prevent creating schedules that violate residency rules.
- Retention-aware deltas: exports should support full and incremental modes. For large tenants, default to delta mode with a compact index and a proof-of-completeness marker.
- Delivery guarantees: configurable retries, resumable uploads, and webhook acknowledgements. Provide delivery receipts surfaced in the Console and via API.
- Export catalog & dashboard: list past exports, status, delivery receipts, size, tokens consumed, and residency/destination metadata. Allow CSV/PDF preview for small samples.
- Scheduling: per-tenant timezone and business-hour windows, throttling settings, and blackout periods. Allow ad-hoc run-now and run-and-archive workflows.
- Retention interplay: automatically respect tenant retention settings when assembling export bundles (redact or omit data beyond retention), and surface discrepancies requiring manual approval.
- Security: manifests signed using customer-managed or Redwood KMS keys (option). Exports encrypted at rest and in transit; optional HSM/KMS integration for private deployments.
- Cost & performance: provide an estimated token/GB cost before schedule creation, and an ability to run a dry-run sample that returns projected duration and storage.

Non-goals: building a full forensic analytics UI (outside scope), supporting arbitrary third-party connectors beyond S3/HTTPS initially.

Success metrics:
- 90% of pilot tenants can configure residency-compliant exports within 30 minutes
- Export failure rate < 1% after retries for scheduled exports
- Delivery receipts available in Console within 60s of successful delivery

Stakeholders: Product, Compliance, Security, Eng (Export Worker, Routing, Storage), Design, Solutions Engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Console: new Export Schedule flow with residency dropdown, timezone, and delivery sink selection
Backend: export worker supports full/delta modes, resumable upload, signed manifests, and per-tenant routing
Security: manifests can be signed with customer KMS key or Redwood-managed key; exports encrypted in transit and at rest
Console: export catalog lists past exports with status, size, delivery receipt, and residency tag
API: endpoints to create schedules, trigger ad-hoc exports, query status, and fetch receipts
Docs: runbook for RBAC, residency constraints, and troubleshooting guide
tasks: PM: finalize residency/routing policy matrix with Security and Legal
Design: create Export Schedule and Catalog mocks with fail states and sample receipts
Eng-Backend: implement export worker with delta/full modes and manifest signing
Eng-Networking: add tenant sink registry and region-aware routing rules
Eng-Infra: S3 multipart resumable uploads and cost accounting hooks
Eng-Console: schedule UI, preview sampler, and catalog pages
Docs: publish runbook and API spec for exports
SE: prepare pilot onboarding checklist and test customers
risks: Large tenant exports could overwhelm worker pools if not throttled—need autoscaling and backpressure
Residency misconfiguration could lead to accidental cross-region delivery—UI validation and policy checks required
Signing/key management raises complexity for private deployments—coordinate with Security early
Export retention vs customer expectations: if retention deletes are applied prior to export, customers may dispute completeness
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (beta internal + 2 customers): enable ad-hoc exports, signed manifests, and S3/HTTPS sinks in a single region
Phase 2 (regional routing): add residency-aware routing, scheduling, and Console catalog; begin security review
Phase 3 (GA): multi-region delivery, KMS key option, retention-aware deltas, and cost estimates exposed in workflow
